------------------------
-- CREATE VIEW CALENDAR
------------------------
CREATE VIEW gold.calendar
AS
SELECT
    *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://awstorageadls.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS QUERY1
